name: h264Software
description: A software H.264 decoder, used only for the profiles Apple's decoders do not handle (High 10 'Hi10P', High 4:2:2, High 4:4:4); every other H.264 stream is still decoded by Apple. Such video plays on the software path. Opt-in, in the `extended-plus` variant. Switched on by the app's owner on 2026-11-12 with the risk accepted, not after a lawyer's opinion (RESEARCH.md section 3.2, point 6).

h264.note: only High 10, 4:2:2 and 4:4:4; the H.264 patent pool is believed active and Apple's licence does not cover this decoder
